note: Curated, non-exhaustive highlights from Microsoft partner AI agent libraries. Descriptions are paraphrased in our own words for what the partner publicly states the agent does; they are not endorsements, resale offers, or verified benchmarks. Each entry links to a comparable AIBAST agent (aibast_equivalent) so a visitor can compare the partner's build against ours. Where the partner's own page states a quantified result (partner_reported_outcome), it is quoted verbatim and is explicitly partner-reported, not independently verified by AIBAST. See each agent's source_url for the partner's own listing.
guidance: Use this catalog to see the variety of Copilot/Dynamics 365 agent patterns partners are shipping in the field, alongside AIBAST's own first-party and demo-proven agents.

partners.name: CongruentX
partners.description: Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Power Platform partner publishing a public library of 40+ Copilot-based sales, insurance, distribution, and professional-services agents.

agents.name: Field Seller AI Agent Copilot
agents.description: Gives on-site field sales reps a location-aware mobile Copilot chat that surfaces store-level KPIs, deliveries, and account context without switching apps.

agents.name: Deal Health
agents.description: Blends SPICED coverage, engagement velocity, and stakeholder multi-threading into a single explainable deal-health score so reps can focus on at-risk opportunities.

agents.name: Sunday Stress Buster
agents.description: A mobile weekly-planning Copilot that answers natural-language questions about pipeline, quota, and tasks so reps can plan the week without opening a dashboard.

agents.name: Generate POV Agent
agents.description: Turns CRM opportunity data into a one-click, on-brand point-of-view document sellers can attach, email, or reuse in a competitive response.

agents.name: Meeting Prep
agents.description: Builds a two-minute pre-meeting brief from CRM, email, and news context, including likely objections and suggested talking points.

agents.name: Sales Process Optimization Agent
agents.description: Analyzes pipeline data to flag qualification gaps and stalled deals, then recommends coaching actions to keep reps on a proven sales process.

agents.name: Policy Issuance Checklist Agent
agents.description: Coordinates policy-issuance handoffs and milestone tracking across underwriting, operations, and service teams to speed time-to-first-value.

agents.name: RFP/Submission Triage & Quote Copilot
agents.description: Triages inbound RFPs and submissions, then guides configuration, pricing, and discount guardrails to speed underwriting quote turnaround.

agents.name: Territory Route & Visit Copilot
agents.description: Plans field-rep routes and visit priorities from account health, order, and service signals to raise visit frequency where it matters most.
agents.partner_reported_outcome: 10–20% more visits per rep per week

agents.name: Churn Risk: Price/Stock/Service Deltas
agents.description: Flags churn risk from price, stock, and service-level deltas so distribution teams can trigger a save play before an account lapses.

agents.name: Account Research Copilot
agents.description: Automates pre-engagement account and buying-committee research for professional-services teams preparing a proposal or SOW.

agents.name: Stakeholder Map + Success Plan
agents.description: Maps client-org stakeholders and builds a shared success plan with milestones to speed onboarding and reduce churn.
agents.partner_reported_outcome: Higher NRR; better multi-threading (10–20% more expansion)
